_comment: V1/V2 for off-shell pi0 decay (pi0 -> gamma V* -> gamma chi chi, m_V 0.2 GeV > m_pi0) on mb_offshell (Sanford-Wang, sphere) and he_offshell_cuboid (BMPT, cuboid). Thresholds, binning and variables copied unchanged from v_config.json (sha256 7058b254...); only the points differ. The stock reference runs use the laptop -O2 build, as for the other sets. Frozen 2026-10-29 before the first off-shell port-against-stock comparison. compare_v.py records this file sha256 in every result.
amended: 2026-10-30, before any off-shell comparison. The stock references run on UVA standard nodes (one core per run) with the container build (gcc 14.2.0, Debian bookworm glibc 2.36; its V0 dump is within 1.8e-15 of the node gcc build and passes test_v0), not the laptop -O2 build named in the comment. The unweighted reference of each point is split into parts with their own seeds (phase0/make_split_ref_cards.py, cards/ref_s: mb 40 parts of 25,000 events, he 10 of 100,000; max_trials guard divided likewise), so every run takes about 10 min. V2 stock sample: the parts' electrons concatenated (validation/merge_stock_parts.py). Stock unweighted se (secondary V1, not a pass criterion): trial-weighted mean of the parts' se, sigma = se / sqrt(accepted events of all parts). Each part has its own 1000-DM burn-in, so the sample holds about N times as many post-burn-in pMax records (each accepted with probability 1) as one long run, expected a few hundred of 1e6 events for mb. The 8 weighted replicas per point are unchanged apart from the machine. Points, variables, binning and thresholds unchanged.

V1.main_reference: stock weighted se (phase0/out/ref_w, 8 replicas, sigma from replica spread)
V1.port_quantity: port weighted se = sum(prob) / trials x Vnum, sigma from per-trial sum of prob (both DM of a trial together)
V1.secondary_reference: stock unweighted se (phase0/out/ref), Poisson on accepted DM
V1.secondary_tolerance: within max(1 %, 2 sigma); expected to show the stock running-pMax bias
V1.also_reported: port two-pass unweighted se against both references (not a pass criterion)

V2.port_sample: all port candidates with prob > 0, weighted by prob (weighted chi2 uses sum of squared weights)
V2.stock_sample: every recoil electron in the stock unweighted event file (phase0/out/ref/<stem>/O2/events.dat), with its incoming DM and parent pion
V2.binning: equal stock population; outer edges open (-inf, +inf)
V2.test: two-sample chi2 of normalised shapes, ndf = n_bins - 1; p-value from the chi2 distribution
V2.fail_closed: any NaN, any bin with stock count < min_expected, or any empty port bin fails the histogram
